parameters.name: AlertLevel
parameters.description:
The alert notification level. Valid values:

- 0: no alert

- 1: reminder

- 2: suspicious

- 3: high-risk.

parameters.name: ExcludeIdList
parameters.description: The list of excluded policy IDs.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:

- **windows**: Windows
- **linux**: Linux.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action to take when the rule is triggered. Valid values:

- **monitor**: Alert.
- **block**: Block.
- **pass**: Allow.

parameters.name: SelectAll
parameters.description: Specifies whether to select all rules.
